Feet ⇄ Inches

Convert length in either direction.
Formula
Feet × 12 = Inches
Inches ÷ 12 = Feet

Feet ⇄ Millimetres

Convert feet to mm or mm to feet.
Formula
Feet × 304.8 = Millimetres
Millimetres ÷ 304.8 = Feet

Millimetres ⇄ Inches

Quick conversion for measurements.
Formula
Millimetres ÷ 25.4 = Inches
Inches × 25.4 = Millimetres

Square metres ⇄ Square feet

Convert area in either direction.
Formula
m² × 10.7639 = sq ft
sq ft ÷ 10.7639 = m²

Price conversion

Enter the sheet rate for the selected thickness, adding ₹1 for bend when applicable.
Converted price—
Formula
(Sheet rate for thickness + bend charge) × 10.764
Bend charge is fixed at ₹1 for every bend type. Example: 44+1 = (44 + 1) × 10.764 = 484.38. Enter 44 alone when there is no bend.

Conversion quick reference

Useful standard values.
1 foot = 12 inches = 304.8 mm
1 inch = 25.4 mm
1 mm ≈ 0.03937 inches
1 metre = 1000 mm
Enter a value in either box. The matching value updates automatically.

Profile / Liner sheet area

Calculate total square metres from sheet length and quantity.
Total area3.307 m²
Formula used
(Length in ft + bend) × 304.8 × sheet width ÷ 1,000,000 × quantity
For inch input, bend is converted from feet to inches (bend × 12) and added to the length before calculating.

The calculator switches width automatically.

(Length + bend) × 304.8 × width × qty ÷ 1,000,000

Inch calculation

Formula
